articles.title: Cybersecurity stocks fall after China software crackdown report
articles.mainIdea: Cybersecurity stocks fall after China software crackdown report
articles.summary: Investing.com: Cybersecurity stocks fall after China software crackdown report. Investing.com -- Shares of several cybersecurity companies dipped on Wednesday after a Reuters report said Chinese authorities have instructed domestic firms to stop using security software from roughly a dozen companies based in the U.S. and Israel, citing national security concerns. Related tickers mentioned: AVGO, CHKP, CYBR, FTNT.
